subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Is a fixed 4096-entry recency-bounded pricing cache the intended compatibility policy for gateways with catalogs larger than that cap?
rationale: The implementation changes which existing model-pricing estimates remain available after refreshes; the code can enforce a chosen policy, but the capacity and eviction contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept bounded LRU policy
options.body: Keep a fixed cap, retain recently used rows that still appear in the refreshed snapshot, and document the resulting cache-miss behavior for excess catalog rows.

options.title: Use a different capacity policy
options.body: Choose a different cap or an explicitly configurable/derived retention policy before finalizing the replacement algorithm.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded LRU policy
recommendation.body: Keep a fixed cap, retain recently used rows that still appear in the refreshed snapshot, and document the resulting cache-miss behavior for excess catalog rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline links this area to their review of a prior competing cache-bound proposal.
